scope: Four fresh normal-rules interim Ashe/Lux matches after observed E wave clearing and release-tick missile-history repair. The human carry is automated only in QA. An 80-minute diagnostic horizon is separate from the recorded 60-minute completion result.

sampling.everyTick: Finite x/y/hp/maxHp/mana/maxMana and bounded health/mana, structure destruction, active team jobs, attacks/arrivals and river claims.
sampling.everyMinute: Full snapshot validation and exact World.fromSnapshot round trip, also at terminal victory.
sampling.counters: Assignment, attack and arrival counts are actor-ticks; they do not prove goal success or count E casts. Wall time is not browser performance.
